panels.title: p50 / p95 / p99 latency by provider

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(started_at) AS t, provider, quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99 FROM inference_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY t, provider ORDER BY t
